title: European Commission reports Scaleup Europe Fund has invested in eight companies
excerpt: The fund, created to provide growth-stage equity, has helped companies raise close to 5 billion euros in two months.
bodyHtml:
According to the European Commission, the Scaleup Europe Fund has invested in eight companies and helped them raise close to €5 billion in two months. The European Commission stated that the fund was created by bringing together public and private investors to form Europe's largest growth-stage equity fund.

The European Commission noted that the fund has supported companies building technologies such as reusable spacecraft, a new generation of ultra-efficient AI chips, and radar satellites that can see through clouds. These companies are building the technologies that will shape the future.

The European Commission also stated that European scale-ups typically raise 50% less capital than their peers in San Francisco. The fund aims to provide the capital these companies need to succeed and stay in Europe.
